tree.heading: Conservation Area
tree.text: The term “Conservation Area” means the Dominguez-Escalante National Conservation Area established by section 460zzz–1(a)(1) of this title.

tree.heading: Council
tree.text: The term “Council” means the Dominguez-Escalante National Conservation Area Advisory Council established under section 460zzz–6 of this title.

tree.heading: Management plan
tree.text: The term “management plan” means the management plan developed under section 460zzz–5 of this title.

tree.heading: Map
tree.text: The term “Map” means the map entitled “Dominguez-Escalante National Conservation Area” and dated September 15, 2008.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

tree.heading: State
tree.text: The term “State” means the State of Colorado.

tree.heading: Wilderness
tree.text: The term “Wilderness” means the Dominguez Canyon Wilderness Area designated by section 460zzz–2(a) of this title.
